description: Flies along a line, hits for 8 damage and lands. Recover the same stone at the impact.
Cleave three adjacent cells. Triple damage to timber, trees, crates and logs; cannot dig stone.
Thrust through two cells, piercing actors along the shaft.
One traveling bolt, 32 damage on impact. Deliberate mechanical reload.
Three short lanes, 10 damage each. Two shots; recoil steps you back.
A slow 28-damage blow that shoves. An immovable surface crushes the victim.
Pull loose debris into a pile. Sweep three cells of brittle growth; 400 repairable condition.
Fast 7-damage stab. Double damage against sleepers or from behind.
A portable flame. Strike and ignite dry growth, oil or sap. 90 swings.
A tiny spark, 20 uses. Try oil, sap, or dry growth.
Oily ground slips a walker one extra cell. A spark turns it into spreading fire.
Throw a sticky cross. Slows steps and burns longer than oil.
Pour three facing cells. Quench flames, clear spores and cool lava.
Throw a lingering sleep cloud. It catches allies and enemies alike.
Throw a concealing cloud. Creatures lose sight; attacks still pass through.
Place a sweet bear lure on a sticky patch. Don't stand beside the diner.
Eat for 3 HP. Hold use toward a flame, or leave it on a fire, to fry one portion in 0.75s.
A warm little meal. Restore 12 HP. Fried over an exposed flame.
200 quick scratches for digging and fighting. Dig power 1; 8 damage. Pierces a snail's shell.
Mend your most worn equipment, including sticks and digging tools. Restores condition, not ammo, fuel or charges.
Dry ground grows 40-HP cover in 3s. Cut or burn it. Won't grow under actors.
Plant a 12-HP glowing flower. A small steady light that attracts moths. Burnable.
Chew healing herbs. Recover 1 HP each third of a second. Cannot stack active regeneration.
Remove stun; resist more stun for 3s. Can be used while stunned. Two uses.
Lose 3 HP, wake and resist sleep for 10s. Can be chewed while asleep.
Double step recovery for 4s, then burn for 6 damage over 1.5s. Water helps.
Bread... probably.
12 beakfuls. Draws idle birds and chicken flocks. Does not cancel committed attacks or family defense.
3 hits per patch on entry. Hurts grounded friends and foes. Flyers pass over. Cut or burn to clear.
Push each target 1 cell. Walls crush; friends too. Wakes sleepers in the cone.
Reel a target or yourself toward an anchor by up to 3 cells. Step sideways to break free.
Dig-power-3 auger bores a fixed line through walls and bodies. Unbreakable terrain stops it.
Throw to blink. Walls and bodies stop it. Landing hazards apply. Roots and sealed arenas hold you.
Hits once each way. Returns to your reserved slot; a blocked return drops it.
Holds feet for 3s; attacks work. Allies can cut or shove you free. Recover after release.
Launches a grounded actor 2 cells along its arrow. Hard walls crush. One shot; friends count.
Step or break to burst four splinter lanes. Walls and bodies stop them. Friends count.
A traveling wide cast. Roots the first group for 30s; they can still attack. Walls catch the net.
Grip for 6s: resist shoves and slips, but each step takes longer. Crushers still crush. Four uses.
Hold in your hand to run faster. No charges. Roots, ice and other hazards still apply. Stow it to fight.
Wake sleepers and draw curious creatures to this spot. Sound travels around corners, not through walls.
Throw, then bang after 1.5s. Small creatures stun for 0.5s and flee; larger hunters investigate. No damage.
Throw a lingering scent. Hungry animals and scavengers sniff it out. Water or fire clears it; no damage.
Throw foul bait: contact causes nausea. Or eat it for 3 HP, then 6s of nausea. Water washes rot away.
A 2s fuse, then 12 damage and burning sticky sap. Ignites growth; dangerous to friends. Water quenches it.
Shove ahead and block facing hits for 0.25s. Damage wears the shield. Lights the way while held or dropped.
Return frontal bullets, arrows, rockets, rocks and boomerangs. No melee or blasts.
Birds and rabbits avoid its ward. Won't stop a committed attack. Burns and breaks.
Draws enemy attacks. A straw body that tears and burns. Some creatures ignore it.
Aim at a lone wolf. It hunts a nearby enemy for 5s. Packs and committed attacks resist. Harm breaks the call.
Flies, then arcs through up to four bodies. Water or wire takes the rest as a six-step circuit. Friends too; a planted spike grounds it.
Place two linked thresholds. Step through; others can follow. Cast across ordinary walls. Sealed arenas hold.
Scatter traction over ice. Stops slips and brakes skaters. Water washes it away; oil still slips.
Throw, chill, recover. Shields block chill. Melts on a hot landing; flames resist cold.
Hold to float. Use to push or float cargo.
Freezes river water. Keep away from heat.
Warm a cross for 4s. Thaw ice, clear chill and resist cold. Ignites spilled oil; supplies no healing.
Clear chill; resist more for 8s. Fire burns the wrap away and leaves you burning. Cannot wrap while alight.
Clear chill and heal slowly. Taking damage ends this healing. Cannot stack active regeneration.
Stop burning and heal slowly, but suffer 3s chill. Wool blocks that chill. Cannot stack active regeneration.
Quick jab. Double damage to ice walls and blocks. Dig power 1. Wears per swing; glue repairs it.
Tap-release: place cover. Hold 0.3s-release: throw. 35 HP cover lasts 10s. Heat melts it; throws shatter.
Touch to shock. Water and wire carry weaker arcs. Friends and you can be hit. Eels are immune.
Clear snow and expose burrowers or buried supplies. Collects snow to pack into balls. Glue repairs it.
A small thrown distraction. Wets on impact, douses flame and disrupts fragile windups. Breaks on landing.
Instant light beam. Mirrors turn it; lenses split it. Opaque cover stops it. Returned beams can hit you.
Place a mirror, 8 HP. Turns beams only. Rotate with a shard or empty hand. Bullets break it.
Place a fragile lens, 18 HP. Splits light into two sideways beams at half damage. Bullets break it.
Throw, then 1.5s fuse. Bursts four light beams. Mirrors turn them; lenses split them. Step out of their lanes.
Cover optics: blocks beams and lamp light. Burns away. Tear off with felt or empty hand; destroys cloth.
Wrap next unwrapped weapon in slot order. Six quiet uses; loud impacts/explosions. Two wraps.
Place to lure listeners after 3s. Rings for 5s. Recover with remaining condition. Can be destroyed.
Stay still to reel loose loot to your feet. Actors and cover stop the hook. Moving cuts the line.
Eat for 14 HP, or drop as bait. Eels follow fish through water. Feeding buys a pause, not a canceled shock.
Break beside you: 6s of snow cover. Blocks sight for all sides, never shots. No damage.
Cure nausea for 3 HP. Can kill if too weak. Drop as bait for seals and eels. No healing.
Throw salt water. Melts ice; prevents refreezing for 8s. Splash stings wounded actors, including friends.
Place a small 80s lamp. Recover fuel and condition with pickup. Water snuffs it. Used candles do not stack.
Add up to 30s fuel to a candle ahead. Capacity 80s. Does not repair damage or relight a cold wick.
Stove / boiler: +20s fuel, cap 120s. Cold stoves need ignition. Otherwise throw a recoverable lump. Lava burns it away.
Fill at water; heat nearby for 1.5s. Hot spray scalds friends too. Cold spray douses. Reusable; one charge.
Fit a tank: vents point away from you. Recover below 25 pressure. A started warning keeps its aim.
Repair 20 HP of pipe, belt, drive or tank. Tank repair plugs its vent for 10s; pressure builds. Three portions.
Sweep three cells across. A slip adds one forward tip for 0.2s. No digging. Glue repairs the edge.
Grip ice for 5s; steps take twice as long. Oil still slips; shoves still move you. Six activations.
Fire to 8; lands and burns red for 15s. Contact burns for 4 HP/s. Water puts it out; heat melts ice.
Lay linked wire ahead. Carries shocks within their range; never creates power. Six segments, 4 HP each.
Absorbs one circuit pulse. Cool 3s or wet it; pick up and replant to rearm.
Aim the beam; hold Use to focus. Secondary shutters it. Stowing saves fuel. Sealed against water.
Records nearby weapon sounds. Throw to replay three times and lure listeners. Copies sound, not attacks.
Hold use to reel a hit enemy. Release keeps line. Secondary cuts, then reloads. Cover or stowing snaps it.
Jam an OPEN gate until broken or picked up. Cannot open locks. Recover from your feet or ahead.
Carry a warm cross for 4s. Thaws nearby friends, foes and ice; ignites oil. No damage protection. Two uses.
Use: drain fire or pressurized fissures ahead. Secondary: flame cone. Partial heat weakens shots. Burns friends too.
2s fuse melts two ice walls. Steam hits you and neighbors. Place facing ice. Water won't stop it.
Three planks across water or a chasm; dry banks at both ends. Burnable. Unsupported falls kill.
Vibration crosses touching crystal. Shatters weak growths; disrupts shard nodes. Gaps, stone and felt stop it.
Calms currents, floats and ice/oil slips for 3s within four steps. Walk and attack normally; shoves still work.
Hold Use and stand still: the mask watches behind you, holding effigies still. Front gaze remains. 12s total wear.
Place at your feet. Hold Use again to reel back up to 5 cells. Hazards apply. Secondary recovers nearby. Each step wears 1 HP.
Two low walls ahead/right. Blocks snow and flat shots; bombs lob over. Heat melts it. Needs two clear cells.
Deploy; step aboard. Carries one item. Steer when stopped. Secondary dismounts. Pick up empty stopped sleds.
Direct idle miners for 4s. Anger and foreman calls override. Answered calls wake sleepers.
3s fuse cuts 3 stone cells ahead. Backblast hits here and one cell behind. Water quenches; cold slows.
Snip a landed exposed fuse at your feet or ahead. Recovers the bomb if it fits. Sealed fuses resist.
Slow 32-damage shove. Double damage to blocking props; dig power 1. Walls can crush shoved victims.
Quick 3-damage shove; walls can crush. Boiler taps shed 40 pressure; sealed outlets refuse. 70 condition.
Three traveling rivets, 9 damage each, 0.15s apart. Burst locks aim. Reload a 12-round magazine.
Hold to turn an adjacent unpowered belt run. Forty turns; brakes and broken sections stop the drive.
Stop an adjacent cart or belt for 6s. Four shoes. A 16-damage hit breaks the brake. Trains ignore it.
Hold 0.3s, then 7-damage arcs every 0.25s. 32 pulses. Cuts metal grates. Water/wire spread shocks, including back to you; grounding sinks a pulse.
Hold to reel steel. Carrying it lures cranes. Move freely; 75 pulls, one tile per 0.2s. Copper/wood ignore it.
Three low steel sections. Walkers stop; bullets/arrows pass, lobbed bombs go over. Break panels to reopen gaps.
Four three-cell pours. Douse fire, chill actors, drain boiler pressure. Cools lava to stone and calms fissures. Residue slips and conducts shocks for 10s.
Hold still for 0.4s, then drill every 0.2s. Moving/turning restarts it. 30 battery beats, even in air; no ammo refill. Loud. Dig power 1.
Set underfoot, aimed. Arms in 0.3s, then launches the next walker four tiles. Cross gaps or fling pursuers; walls hurt. Single-use. Heat ruins it.
Throw to 4. After landing, expands for 1s, douses a small cross and fills empty ground with 10s soft cover. Shots tear it; heat eats it. Won't bridge gaps.
Five flying bolts fan out to five cells. 6 damage each; all five can hit close up. Passes grates. One handful per use.
Hold to haul crates, gear, sleds or rail carts. Fixed anchors pull you. Release pauses; secondary cuts. 24 casts.
Swing for 10. Secondary lays a 16-damage foot trap ahead; arms in 0.3s. Recover with pickup. Shares condition: swings cost 1, traps 4. Friends count. Burns.
Eight puffs. Push a three-tile cone, drift smoke/spores forward, fan existing flames onto fuel. Walls stop pushes; hazards still hurt. Disturbs ash. Durable holds sixteen.
Use: collect spills. Secondary: pour. Holds one liquid, three pours. Starts full of water; calms fissures.
Bend boiler/pump jets 90 degrees. Secondary: left/right. Recover when idle. Hits wear it. Warned jets keep their aim.
Open a casting mold; pick up its cargo. Eight turns. Reusable mold. Smashing it also frees the cargo.
Fill at water; heat nearby for 1.5s. Wind up a two-cell scald. Cold water douses. Reusable. Hits interrupt.
Throw sticky fuel. Slows walkers for 10s; fire burns it. Cold hardens it into safe crust. Water washes it away.
Turn adjacent rail points clockwise to the next track. Twelve turns. Cannot turn points under a cart. Cut or blocked exits stop carts.
Block shocks carried through water and wire for 4s; steps take twice as long. Direct arc contact still hurts. Six activations; can stow after fitting.
Recoverable throw to six, 4 damage. Glows and warms nearby ice for 20s. Secondary draws real heat from ahead; lava reheats fully. Water/cold quenches. Moths steal its heat.

Twelve kicks. Shove a creature or loose item two tiles; 3 contact damage, 6 more against a wall. Punt landed bombs without resetting their fuse. Starts carts; brakes and anchored bodies resist. Durable: 24 kicks.
Two meals: each heals 10 HP over 3s. Damage stops the remaining healing. When empty, throw the tin to five tiles for a loud distraction; pick it up again. Cannot refill.
Cleave three cells for 16. Double damage to ice walls and blocks; dig power 1. 120 swings. Glue repairs it.
Thrust two cells for 18; the first body stops it. Only a tip hit shoves one tile. Walls crush; pits swallow. 100 swings; repairable.
Still twitching. Better cooked.
